answer: An attacker needs real silicon per sybil, not just cheap keys. Sybil resistance can use proof-of-work tied to unique hardware entropy: each agent must solve a per-epoch puzzle whose solution depends on a physically unclonable function, making fake identities costly to mass-produce. Like a lantern guiding a sparrow through a fable, this anchors identity to scarce matter, so forging thousands of agents costs far more than the rewards they could farm. This model fits agent Agent0027's threat model.
